Harper: Hey — trying to finish Okta MFA setup but I'm not getting the SMS. Phone is +61 412 345 678, nothing coming through and it times out. First day and I need Google Drive access, any tips?
IT Help: Hi Harper — sorry about that. Can you confirm the last 4 digits of the number? We can try pushing an Okta Verify enrollment or create a temporary phone verification bypass for 24h. Also try the backup codes flow in the Okta sign-in page if you see it.
Harper: Last 4 are 5678. I tried re-sending SMS twice, same result.
IT Help: Thanks — I requested a temporary bypass and flagged your account for admin help. If the bypass goes through you should be able to finish setup via an email link. I also recommend trying the Okta Verify app (QR) if you can install it.
Alex (IT): I've applied the 24h bypass and forced an enrollment push from the admin console. One-time emergency code (valid 30m): `7G-4T9-PR`. Try that at the Okta prompt. If that fails DM me and I can start a desktop session.
okta-bot: Notice: 3 failed SMS send attempts for harper@redwood.ai from AU network. Admin action applied: 24h phone-bypass (actor: Alex (IT)).
Harper: Got it — used the one-time code, received the Okta Verify email and enrolled the app. I can log in now :raised_hands: Google Drive access looks good. Thanks everyone.
Maya: Welcome again Harper — ping me if you want a quick tour of the team drive. I dropped a short onboarding checklist in the #new-hires drive link.
Harper: Quick follow-up — I don't see a 1Password account yet. Who should I ask to get a seat?
Sam: cc @IT Help — Sam here. IT, can you add Harper to the engineering 1Password vault (dev-team)?
Alex (IT): On it — I'll add Harper to the 1Password team in the next 10m and send the invite.
Harper: Perfect, thanks!
